audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Decisive Strike breaks free of slows, never gives its 8s cooldown, and never says Courage is a shield rather than only damage reduction.
audit.why: Riot's Q text is explicit: Garen 'gains a burst of Move Speed, breaking free of all slows affecting him', and the ability is an auto-attack reset. That is the whole reason Gnar's Boomerang slow does not hold him off, and the empowered-attack wind-up is the tell to step back. Courage carries a shield flag plus tenacity, so it eats a burst window on 22/19.5/17/14.5/12.
